Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscalculated the lifespans despite correct dates gathered by WebSurfer. They incorrectly concluded Hardyal Singh lived ~90.25 years and Antonio Caggiano ~89.25 years, reversing the true comparison. In reality, Caggiano (1889-01-30 to 1979-10-23) lived about 90 years 8 months, while Hardyal Singh (1928-11-28 to 2018-08-17) died at age 89. This arithmetic error led to the wrong final answer.
